<h3>Wegovy® Pill Self-Pay Model Terms and Conditions</h3>

<p><strong>Eligibility:</strong> This offer is available to patients who are self-paying.</p>

<p><strong>Offer Details:</strong></p>
<ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1">
  <li>Pay $149 for each month of Wegovy® 1.5 mg, Pay $199 for each month of Wegovy® 4 mg, and Pay $299 for each month of Wegovy® 9 mg and 25 mg tablets</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Restrictions:</strong></p>
<ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-1">
  <li>Patient must have a valid prescription for the brand being filled.</li>
  <li>Patients may only participate in this program if they have been prescribed Wegovy® for an FDA-approved indication within Wegovy's labeling.</li>
  <li>This offer operates outside of any third-party insurance and is not valid for prescriptions submitted for reimbursement, in whole or in part, under Medicare, VA, DoD, Tricare, or similar federal or state programs, including any state pharmaceutical assistance program or commercial / private insurance.</li>
  <li>If you have Medicare, Medicare Part D, a Medicare Advantage Prescription drug plan, or any other state or federal health insurance plan, you agree to the following:
    <ul class="list-[circle] pl-5 mt-2 space-y-1">
      <li>You will not ask your insurance to pay you back for the money that you self-paid for your medication using this offer.</li>
      <li>You will not attempt to count the cost of this medicine toward your insurance deductible or out-of-pocket limit.</li>
      <li>If you are asked by your insurance company about this prescription, you will tell your insurance company that you bought this medicine outside of its prescription plan using the Wegovy® self-pay offer and that you are not seeking reimbursement or submitting a claim for this prescription.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>The purchase of the prescription under this program is not conditioned on current or any future purchases of Wegovy® or any other items or services that could become billable to any Government Program.</li>
  <li>Novo Nordisk reserves the right to rescind, revoke or amend this offer without notice at any time. Valid only at participating pharmacies.</li>
  <li>Cannot be combined with other offers or discounts.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>By using this offer, you agree to the terms above and confirm your eligibility.</strong></p>

<p>For questions, contact Novo Nordisk at 1-866-727-6500 or visit NovoCare.com.</p>
